metadata.name: JEE Main & NEET UG Official Curriculum Specification
metadata.description: 5-Level Taxonomy: exam -> subject -> official_unit -> topic -> question_modes

modes_legend.NUMERICAL: Calculations, formula evaluation, dual-pass math verification
modes_legend.DIAGRAM: Deterministic vector plots, ray optics, circuit diagrams, apparatus, waveforms
modes_legend.STRUCTURE: Chemical structures, reactions, molecular geometry, biological models

rules: Strictly NO decorative or free-form generative AI images (ai_image_generation: false).
Deterministic renderers for STEM diagrams and chemical structures.
Authentic PYQ or deterministic plots for NEET biology visual content.
AI generation must strictly stay within approved unit topics and question modes.
